absent: Full memory layout, sizes, and padding of pending, queue, timer, task, signal, and handler structures beyond observed field usage.
Complete get_signal dequeue and user delivery path after stop and trap handling, including handler lookup and frame setup.
Internals of preparation, eligibility, completion, sighand locking, signalfd notification, user count, and timer reference helpers.
Group stop completion counting, continue handling, and parent notification payload construction beyond reason selection.
Architecture hooks for stop need, stop entry, and address untagging, plus probe denial predicate behavior.
Task work addition and cancellation paths and exit marker lifecycle beyond atomic drain loop.
Freezer and cgroup frozen accounting and scheduler wakeup conditions around traced, stopped, and frozen sleeps.
Signal generation and delivery trace points and numeric constant values for signals, origins, events, and control bits.

findings.text: Flush operation for current thread removes interval timer originated entries from both private pending queue and process shared pending queue while preserving other entries, presented as callable without arguments acting on current context.

Initialization helper for preallocated timer queue entries associates caller user counts, clears prior notification details, and marks entry as preallocated, reporting failure when counts unavailable and success otherwise.

Send routine for timer expiry resolves target, validates queue eligibility under lock, updates timer sequence and periodic marker, then either queues to pending, parks on ignored list, drops oneshot after periodic, or leaves already queued entry untouched while emitting generation trace.

Notification entry validates that supplied code carries trap shape, runs pending task work when present, then under signal lock builds notification details from current identity and enters traced stop as trapped reason before returning resulting signal number.

Drain routine for current task repeatedly steals whole callback list atomically and invokes each callback in order with scheduling opportunity between invocations until list stays empty, substituting exit marker handling when task is exiting.

Central signal handling entry clears notification state and pending work, rejects when no pending work or when probes deny, freezes if required, then under lock loop processes continued and stopped notifications, forced termination, group stop participation, and job control or freezer traps before dequeue.

Traced stop entry commits current task to traced sleep with supplied exit code reason message and optional details, notifies appropriate parents, sleeps until tracer resumes, then clears transient trap state and refreshes pending computation before returning resumed code.

Flush helper snapshots pending mask, walks queue safely against removal, keeps entries whose origin differs from timer by adding their numbers to retain set, and for timer origin clears number from snapshot, unlinks entry and releases it, finally merging snapshot with retain set into pending mask.

Timer queue helper notifies file based monitors, selects shared pending for process wide addressing and private pending otherwise, appends entry at tail, sets corresponding number in pending mask, then completes signal toward target.

Target resolver looks up timer pid with stored type, and when addressing is not thread specific plus looked up task shares thread group with current and current is not exiting, it substitutes current as delivery target.

Send path copies timer signal sequence into queue sequence and derives periodic marker from requeue pending status while holding sighand, ensuring dequeue race protection and allowing ignored handling to separate periodic from oneshot expiries.

Ignored periodic expiry with no existing ignored linkage acquires an extra reference and parks on ignored list, already parked periodic expiry does nothing, and ignored oneshot expiry following earlier periodic unlinks prior ignored node and drops its reference instead of queuing.

When timer queue node is already linked at delivery attempt after successful preparation, send path treats signal as already pending, keeps existing reference and linkage unchanged, and reports that outcome in generation trace.

Unignore scan walks process ignored timer head, skips entries whose stored number differs from unignored number, unlinks matching nodes, requires their queue nodes to be empty, then under read side protection requeues toward eligible target or drops reference when no eligible target remains.
Alternate unignore variant implements empty operation with no list walk, no reference changes, and no requeue, preserving interface while disabling ignored timer revival for its configuration.

Debugger signal path records stop dequeued marker before stop, returns unchanged when debugger cancels number to zero, rebuilds notification details as user originated with parent identity when number changed, and requeues signal when new number is blocked or fatal pending exists.

Address tag helper strips architecture tags from fault related notification layouts including trap number and machine and bound and protection key and performance variants, and leaves kill and timer and poll and child and realtime and system layouts untouched.

Flush entry holds sighand signal lock across both private and shared queue mutations using scoped guard, so mask and list updates for current thread and process are atomic against concurrent signal queue and dequeue activity.

Send path holds read side protection across target resolution and requires successful sighand acquisition before eligibility test, sequence update, preparation, ignored list changes, and pending insertion, releasing sighand on all exits including early absent target and lock failure.

Unignore execution assumes sighand already held by caller for ignored list walk and unlink, acquires only read side protection for target eligibility and requeue, and defers timer rearm decisions to delivery path because timer lock ordering forbids acquiring timer lock under sighand.

Traced stop releases signal lock around architecture hook then reacquires before state changes, holds lock across traced state and control flag and trap data updates, releases before task list read lock notification and frozen sleep, and reacquires after wake before clearing transient state.

Work drain uses atomic compare exchange on task work head to steal list without locks, uses interrupt protected pi lock acquire and release as barrier against concurrent cancellation of non head entries, then invokes callbacks without holding that lock.

Group stop initiation and participation update stop counts, exit code, and pending bits under signal lock with stopped state checks, while parent notifications for completion and for continued or stopped transitions use task list read lock without holding signal lock.

Freezer trap expects signal lock on entry and releases it on both early return when other traps remain and on sleep path, while job control trap expects signal lock held across its notify or stop invocation and leaves unlocking to caller.

Pending queue structure pairs a signal number mask with a list of queued notification nodes, where mask bits mirror queued membership, flush recomputes mask from survivors, and queue insertion sets bit while appending node.

Timer object observed through usage links a preallocated queue node carrying immutable signal number, target pid with addressing type, signal and queue sequence counters, periodic marker and requeue status, and an ignored list node for parked expiries.

Task and process structures observed through usage link private pending and shared pending, ignored timer head, sighand actions and lock, blocked mask, job control flags, ptrace state with message and last details and exit code, plus group stop count and exit code and flags for exit and stop reporting.

Traced stop progresses from fatal and traced checks to setting traced sleep state and traced flag with memory ordering, recording trap data, optionally participating in group stop, clearing stop and notify traps then trapping marker, notifying parents, entering frozen sleep, and on resume clearing listening and frozen markers and refreshing pending.

Group stop starts when stop pending absent and stop dequeued present without group exit or exec, records stop signal once, marks self and peers pending with consume semantics while counting participants and waking or notifying them, then either sleeps in stopped state reporting completion when last, or schedules stop trap when ptraced.

Job control trap dispatch uses seized mode to select trap number when no group stop active and to invoke notify helper, and uses non seized mode to invoke direct traced stop with stored stop signal, covering stop participation signaling to tracer.

Freezer trap first returns to caller loop when any pending or trap bits beyond freeze remain, otherwise sets interruptible freezable sleep, clears thread pending marker, sleeps frozen, then clears notification signal and runs pending work before caller retries.

Get signal outer loop relocks after each step and in order handles group exit or exec by forcing termination, handles stop pending via group stop with retry, dispatches job control traps or freezer trap with retry, and handles continued versus stopped parent reports by consuming flag mask then notifying under task list lock before relocking.

Work drain loops stealing head until null, treats null with exiting flag as request to process exit marker once, otherwise ends, and for non null head invokes chain in linkage order before attempting another steal to catch additions made by callbacks.

Architecture stop hook may fault on user stack and block, so holding signal lock across it would delay signals; implementation releases lock before hook and reacquires after, requiring all stop bookkeeping to occur after reacquire.

Ignored timer unexpectedly found already linked on pending list indicates broken mutual exclusion between ignored and pending linkage; implementation warns once, skips requeue, and leaks associated reference rather than corrupting lists.

Tracer detach or fatal signal arrival racing with trap entry could leave task sleeping unobserved; implementation rechecks traced linkage and fatal pending after architecture hook and returns without sleeping when either condition holds.

Preemption between task list unlock and sleep can extend traced stop latency by a timer tick due to tracer observing queued state; implementation disables preemption across that window except on realtime configuration where frozen path sleeping locks forbid disabling.

Stop signal numbers outside stop mask and missing expected stop signals on trap entry indicate caller logic errors; implementation warns once while continuing with supplied or stored values rather than enforcing hard failure.

Origin codes distinguish timer originated queue entries subject to interval flush from user originated entries synthesized when debugger changes signal number, with flush keyed on timer origin and rebuild keyed on user origin.

Stop and trap reasons distinguish group stop participation, debugger trap, and continued or stopped parent notifications, selecting notification payloads and whether completion goes to ptracer, real parent, or both.

Stop event code shifted into trap code upper bits identifies stop traps and drives clearing of notify pending on trap entry, with seized job control path composing signal number with shifted event value.

Job control bits encode stop pending and consume and dequeued, stop signal mask, trap stop and notify and freeze with trapping marker, plus listening and stopped and traced states, coordinated under signal lock to sequence group stop and trap handling.

Task sleep states for traced and stopped and interruptible freezable, process flags for group exit and stop reporting and continued reporting, and addressing selector for thread versus process delivery together define stop, freeze, exit, and queue target modes.

Signal numbers for trap and kill shape debugger notifications and forced termination, where notify validates trap shaped codes, group exit or exec forces kill delivery, and unptraced group stop sleeps until continue or kill arrival.
